title: Keyboard settings-panel surface is dead: S/arrows/Enter are never collected into the phase-1 keys buffer, so every new key mapping is unreachable
detail: The collection switch only buffers P/Space/D/T/M/Esc; .S/.Up/.Down/.Left/.Right/.Enter fall into `case:`. The emit loop reads keys[:keys_n], so S never opens/closes the panel (phase-2 still maps S to Set_Lane), arrows/Enter never navigate/adjust. Keyboard has zero panel access; input parity broken; PR claims otherwise.
recommended_fix: Collect .S/.Up/.Down/.Left/.Right/.Enter in the Key_Press collection switch and enlarge `keys: [5]Key` (already at capacity: P+D+T+M+Esc = 5), e.g. [10]Key, so the silent `keys_n < len(keys)` drop cannot eat them.

title: Pipe demolish popover at UI scale x1.25/x1.50: button insets scale but popover height does not — the demolish button slides up over the title text
detail: popover_rect scales width but takes h raw (64). At x1.50 the button top is pop.y+64-54=pop.y+10 with height 39; the 15px title occupies pop.y+8..23 — the button draws over it (drawn after). At x1.25 top=pop.y+19, partial overlap. The node popover (92) clears. Hit-tests stay aligned (shared rect); the read does not.
recommended_fix: Scale the popover height through hud_f as well (h := hud_f(v, POPOVER_H_PIPE) at both call sites + the app's hit-test calls), or clamp the button's top below the title line.

title: Panel open while placement armed (pad Y): every mouse click on the modal is silently dead — ui-press is gated on placing_eff < 0 while the panel suppresses the rest
detail: Arm placement (tray), then pad Y opens the panel (controller_map's .Y has no placing gate). Mouse left-presses skip on_ui_press (placing_eff >= 0), and the panel-open branch suppresses tray/drag, so rows + chip are unclickable by mouse. touch_map's panel-open branch has no placing gate, so touch still works — a device divergence on a visible modal. Esc/pad recover.
recommended_fix: In the left-press branch, call on_ui_press when inp.panel_open regardless of placing_eff (the modal owns the surface), matching the touch panel-open path.

title: parse_mode_table marks house_roofs set before validating elements — a malformed (non-array) entry applies a {0,0,0,0} transparent roof
detail: roofs_set = true is written before the per-element type check; a non-array element leaves roofs[i] zero-initialized ({0,0,0,0}, fully transparent) and palette_apply_mode copies the whole array into house_roofs. The tolerant-parse doctrine elsewhere keeps the base value on malformed entries; this path does not.
recommended_fix: Set roofs_set only after all four elements validate (track a parsed count / ok flag), so a partial malformed array falls back to the base roofs like an absent token.

title: Settings checksum is an additive u8 sum of 3 payload bytes — sum-preserving multi-byte corruption passes and applies wrong-but-in-range settings silently
detail: Truncated/zero-length/wrong-version/single-byte-corrupt files are all guarded, but any corruption that preserves (b2+b3+b4) mod 256 (e.g. palette byte +1, motion byte -1) passes the checksum; the range checks then admit the mutated values. Result: silently wrong persisted a11y settings — exactly the 'corrupt file' class the format claims to default on.
recommended_fix: Use a position-sensitive check (e.g. FNV-1a over the 3 payload bytes, stored in the same 1-byte budget truncated, or widen the field in a v2 format) so byte swaps/moves also fail to defaults.
